steps: Identity: contract ref CW-2025-0417-CIV and subcontractor Ridgeway Civil Engineering LLC match the Agreement (p1).
Term: work 2025-04-30 lies within 2025-01-05 to 2026-09-30 (as extended by A1 and A2; it is also before the original completion date 2025-09-27) - in term.
Period 2025-04-30 to 2025-04-30 includes the work date 2025-04-30.
Application date 2025-05-05 is not before the period end 2025-04-30 and is 5 days after it (limit 21) - in time.
Unit: m3 = Schedule 1 unit for A.12.050 (p17).
Records: A.12.050 is not listed in Schedule 5 (p27), so no record is a condition of payment; the blank record_ref is not a finding.
Base rate A.12.050 = 52.40 (Sch 1, p17); no instrument (S1, A1, S2, A2, A3; p38-43) substitutes it; not in Sch 2A or 2B.
Zone: Z1 Compound factor 1 (Series A listed in Sch 2, p20): 52.40 x 1 = 52.40.

Ground: A.12.050 is listed in Sch 3 (p23). The classification is the Engineer's (Cl.5) recorded at the point of excavation on the daily excavation record (S4); no record is supplied. Work 2025-04-30 is not after 27 Sep 2025, so 27A does not fix G2; S4's G2 default needs it shown that no classification was recorded on the day, which a record that is merely not supplied cannot show. The application's G4 is not taken as the record -> one value per class.
Uplifts: night_work N; 2025-04-30 is a Wednesday (working day); A.12.050 is in neither Sch 4 Part 1 nor Part 2 - none.
Bands: A.12.050 has no Sch 4 Part 3 band (band_pct 100 given) - no rebate.
Rounding: once, after the whole build-up, to the halala, half up (Cl.28).
Billed check: 390 x 72.05 = 28099.50 = billed amount (no amount_arithmetic). Billed rate 72.05 equals only the G4 value, so rate_differs depends on the class.

Schedule 4 Parts 1-3 p24-25 (no uplift or band for A.12.050)
Schedule 5 p27; Cl.46 p8 (no record required for A.12.050)
Instruments S1, A1, S2, A2, A3 p39-43 (none touches A.12.050)
note: The application states G4 Weathered Rock. The contract fixes the classification by the Engineer (Cl.5), recorded on the daily excavation record on the day of excavation (S4); that record is not supplied (record_ref blank), so the claim's G4 is not taken as it. S4's default (G2 where no classification was recorded on the day) cannot be applied because not supplied is not the same as not recorded; 27A's G2 rule covers only work after 27 Sep 2025. Values are therefore given for G1-G5; the billed 72.05 / 28099.50 equals the G4 alternative. If the record showed no classification on the day, S4 gives G2: 52.40 / 20436.00. ground_differs_from_record cannot be tested without the record. Band state is irrelevant (no band for A.12.050); daily limits, duplicates and other-line rules not applied.

Unit: m3 = Schedule 1 unit for A.12.030 (p17).

Record: A.12.030 needs a Daily Excavation Record, series DX (Sch 5, p27). DX-90060 is series DX, area S-01 Platform North (= line work area), date 10/06/2025 (= work date), signed by the foreman and countersigned by the Engineer's representative. Text 'trench dig 100 cube, 3 m deep section' evidences trench excavation 2 m to 4 m deep (A.12.030; P13) of 100 m3 = billed 100.
Base rate A.12.030 = 47.60 (Sch 1, p17); no instrument substitutes it; not in Sch 2A/2B.
Zone: Z1 Compound factor 1 (Series A, Sch 2 p20): 47.60 x 1 = 47.60.

Ground: A.12.030 is listed in Sch 3 (p23). The daily excavation record, on which material is classified at the point of excavation (S4), states G3 Cemented Fill; work 2025-06-10 is before 28 Sep 2025 so 27A does not apply. The application states G4 -> ground_differs_from_record. G3 factor 1.12: 47.60 x 1.12 = 53.312.
Uplifts: night_work N; 2025-06-10 is a Tuesday (working day); no rest-day uplift (A.12.030 not in Sch 4 Part 2).
Bands: A.12.030 has no Sch 4 Part 3 band - no rebate.
Rounding once (Cl.28): 53.312 -> 53.31.
Billed check: rate 47.60 differs from 53.31 -> rate_differs; 100 x 47.60 = 4760.00 = billed amount -> no amount_arithmetic.

steps: Identity: contract ref CW-2025-0417-CIV and subcontractor Ridgeway Civil Engineering LLC match the Agreement (p1).

Unit: m2 = Schedule 1 unit for D.41.040 (p18).

Record: D.41.040 needs a Compaction Test Certificate, series CT (Sch 5, p27). CT-00267 is series CT, area S-01 Platform North (= line work area), date 07/02/2026 (= work date), signed by the foreman and countersigned by the Engineer's representative; 'capping layer, 258 m2 placed and compacted' evidences D.41.040, 258 m2 = billed 258.
Base rate D.41.040 = 32.60 (Sch 1, p18); no instrument substitutes it; not in Sch 2A/2B.
Zone: Z2 North Spur factor 1.06 (Series D listed in Sch 2, p20): 32.60 x 1.06 = 34.556.
Ground: D.41.040 is not listed in Sch 3 - no ground factor.
Uplifts: night_work N. 2026-02-07 is a Saturday (rest day) but D.41.040 is not in Sch 4 Part 2 (nor Part 1) - no uplift.
Bands (Sch 4 Part 3): D.41.040 1 to 3,500 m2 100%; 3,501 to 14,500 95%; above 14,500 92%; counted from zero in Contract Year 2 (from 2026-01-05, Cl.3A). Band state not known.
Rounding once after the whole build-up, half up (Cl.28).

Billed check: 258 x 34.56 = 8916.48, not the billed 8828.25. Division at the 3,500 band edge (Cl.28/Sch 4 Part 3): 207 x 34.56 = 7153.92 plus 51 x 32.83 = 1674.33, total 8828.25 = billed amount. A division reproduces it -> amount_arithmetic unresolved, not a finding.
Billed rate 34.56 equals the band-1 rate (and the rate of the first part of that division); rate_differs depends on the band state -> unresolved.

note: Band state unknown: one value per band (whole quantity in the band). The billed 8828.25 is exactly what Clause 28 gives if 3,293 m2 of D.41.040 had already been measured in Contract Year 2, so that 207 m2 fall in band 1 at 34.56 and 51 m2 in band 2 at 32.83; that split is therefore listed as unresolved rather than an arithmetic error. The line's single billed rate 34.56 does not show the split. Zone Z2 is taken from the line: Cl.4 makes the zone the place of execution and names no document, and the record identifies only the work area. Saturday work: no rest-day uplift because D.41.040 is not eligible. Other-line rules not applied.
